jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada; Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision. The AI-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management.

Customer Success Manager

Location: Vancouver, BC OR Toronto, ON
Work Environment: Hybrid

Role Summary

Exiger is seeking a Customer Success Manager based in Canada to manage and grow relationships with enterprise customers across the Americas and broader NoAM region.

This is a hands-on, technology-forward role for someone who is curious about how AI is changing the way businesses operate and who can become deeply knowledgeable about both our customers and the Exiger platform. You will work with customers to understand their objectives, organizational structure, stakeholders and use cases, then help translate the capabilities of Exiger’s technology into measurable business outcomes.

You will own relationships throughout the post-sale customer lifecycle, driving adoption, utilization and value realization while protecting renewals and identifying opportunities to expand the partnership. Success in this role requires the ability to move comfortably between detailed product and workflow conversations, strategic discussions with senior stakeholders and the commercial realities of managing an enterprise account.

What You’ll Do

- Own the day-to-day and strategic customer relationship across a portfolio of enterprise customers in the Americas and NoAM.

- Build multithreaded relationships across customer organizations, developing strong connections with users, champions, executive sponsors and other key stakeholders.

- Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business, organizational structure, objectives, challenges and evolving priorities.

- Drive adoption and utilization of Exiger’s technology, helping customers understand how our intelligence, technology and AI capabilities can support their specific use cases.

- Become highly proficient in the Exiger platform, taking hands-on responsibility for standard administration, configuration, and training for customers.

- Help customers identify opportunities to automate traditionally manual workflows and use Exiger technology to respond more effectively as risks and requirements change.

- Own the renewal outcome for each customer, d evelop customer success plans and proactively track progress against agreed business outcomes, adoption goals and measures of value.

- Execute EVR Success Plans, create Success Stories, and align with the economic buyer.

- Lead Quarterly Business Reviews and other strategic customer discussions that demonstrate value, surface opportunities and establish clear priorities for the partnership.

- Manage the full customer renewal lifecycle, from ongoing engagement and value realization through contract renewal and partnership expansion.

- Identify customer health risks early and take proactive action to address adoption, utilization, stakeholder or service concerns.

- Partner closely with Sales to identify and develop opportunities to expand Exiger’s impact within existing customer organizations.

- Coordinate across Product, Delivery, Application Support, Sales and other teams to ensure Exiger’s full suite of expertise is brought to bear on each customer account.

- Represent the voice of the customer internally, translating feedback, emerging requirements and use cases into actionable insights for Exiger teams.

- Ensure customer issues and escalations are managed effectively, communicated clearly and resolved as quickly as possible.

- Maintain strong internal visibility into customer activity, engagement, opportunities, feedback and risk.

- Manage competing priorities across a portfolio of customers while maintaining a consistently high standard of customer experience.

- Travel periodically within the Americas and NoAM to support customers and business needs.

What You Need

- 2+ years of customer-facing experience in SaaS, technology, consulting, or similarly complex environments.

- Demonstrated ability to navigate enterprise organizations and build multithreaded relationships across functions and seniority levels, communicating confidently with stakeholders from hands-on users to senior executives.

- Strong technical curiosity about AI and emerging technology, with the ability to understand and explain it to customers (no engineering background required).

- Ability to quickly build fluency in a complex platform and connect its capabilities to customer outcomes.

- Strong commercial awareness, including identifying growth opportunities and navigating renewals and retention.

- Strong presentation and facilitation skills, including delivering customer training.

- Proactive, consultative approach — curious about the "why" behind customer requests, not just the "what."

- Demonstrated ability to manage complex, ambiguous customer needs and excellent organization and project management skills across a portfolio of accounts.

- Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment with strong sense of ownership and accountability for customer outcomes.

- Experience with third-party risk, supply chain risk, procurement, regulatory compliance, due diligence or adjacent disciplines is an advantage.

- Experience with Gainsight or another dedicated Customer Success platform is a plus.

- Ability to work in a hybrid capacity from our London office and support customers across the Americas and NoAM.

Why You’ll Love Working at Exiger

- Do work that matters. Help customers tackle complex, real-world challenges across supply chains, risk and resilience, with work that can have a meaningful impact on businesses, governments and the communities they serve.

- Work at the forefront of AI and data. Be part of a team applying advanced technology to difficult problems where better intelligence and faster action can make a real difference.

- Join a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, collaboration and a shared commitment to excellence.

- Receive a competitive compensation package that recognizes the value and impact you bring.

- Work flexibly through a hybrid approach that balances time at home and in the office, where applicable.

- Benefit from a focus on wellness and employee health , supporting sustainable performance and wellbeing.

- Keep growing through purposeful career development programs designed to build your expertise and help you take on increasingly challenging work.

This posting is for a newly created role; artificial intelligence tools may be used to support candidate screening and evaluation; the expected base salary range for this position is 110,000-135,000 CAD annually, depending on qualifications.

Exiger is named a Leader in the Gartner ®  Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management, twice selected as one of Fast Company's 'Brands That Matter,' and recipient of the Third Party Risk Association's Innovator Award, Exiger's technology has been recognized by leading analyst evaluations and 50+ awards. Learn more at  Exiger.com  and follow Exiger on  LinkedIn .

At Exiger, our values define how we work and why we lead. We are mission-inspired, imagination-driven, trust-anchored, and compassion-focused—committed to building technology that makes the world safer, more transparent, and more resilient.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

Exiger’s hybrid work policy is periodically reviewed and adjusted to align with evolving business needs.

Customer Success Manager, Sr. Manager — Public Sector

Location: McLean, VA
Work Environment: Hybrid

Role Summary

Exiger partners with government agencies and organizations operating in complex, mission-critical environments where supply chain visibility, regulatory compliance, risk management, and operational resilience are essential. As our Public Sector business grows, we are expanding our Customer Success organization across Federal Civilian, the Department of War, the Defense Industrial Base, and related public-sector programs.

We are seeking a Customer Success Manager, Sr. Manager — Public Sector to serve as the primary post-sale strategic partner for a portfolio of customers. Reporting to Public Sector Customer Success leadership, you will drive onboarding, platform adoption, value realization, retention, and long-term account success.

You will develop trusted relationships across customer organizations, translate mission priorities into actionable success plans, and coordinate with Product, Delivery, Support, Analytics, and Sales to achieve measurable outcomes. Depending on the needs of each account, you will deliver strategic, high-touch support or leverage scalable engagement programs, enablement resources, and self-service tools to accelerate time to value.

This role is ideal for a proactive, customer-focused professional who enjoys building relationships, navigating complex stakeholder environments, and translating technology into meaningful mission outcomes.  The successful candidate will be comfortable balancing strategic account leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced AI powered environment – where moving with urgency, adapting quickly, and helping our customers stay ahead of evolving threats are essential to mission success.

What You Will Do

Customer Success Account Management

- Manage a portfolio of Public Sector customer accounts, serving as the primary post-sale point of contact and trusted advisor.

- Build strong relationships with Public Sector stakeholders, program leaders, mission owners, analysts, technical users, and executive sponsors.

-   Lead customer meetings, status updates, workshops, executive briefings, and business reviews that clearly demonstrate progress, outcomes, and value.

-   Develop tailored success and adoption plans that align Exiger’s platform capabilities with each customer’s mission priorities and business objectives.

- Create and maintain repeatable engagement programs, enablement materials, and self-service resources that accelerate adoption and time to value.

- Monitor customer health, platform usage, stakeholder engagement, adoption, satisfaction, and renewal timelines across assigned accounts.

- Proactively identify risks to adoption, customer satisfaction, and retention, then develop and execute mitigation plans in partnership with internal stakeholders.

- Drive retention and support successful renewals by documenting outcomes, demonstrating measurable value, and maintaining alignment with evolving customer priorities.

- Identify opportunities to expand platform adoption, use cases, and stakeholder engagement within existing accounts.

-   Partner cross-functionally with Product, Support, Delivery, Analytics, Sales, and Customer Success Operations to resolve issues, address customer needs, and continually improve the customer experience.

What You Need

Required

- Three to five years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, and Technical Account Management with  another customer-facing role.

- Experience supporting public sector, especially Federal Civilian, the Department of War, or the Defense Industrial Base.

- Experience managing customer relationships in a SaaS, GovTech, data, analytics, or technology-enabled environment.

- Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and executive leadership.

- Experience driving customer onboarding, adoption, retention, renewals, or other measurable Customer Success outcomes.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to deliver presentations, training, customer meetings, and executive briefings.

- Ability to learn technical concepts and communicate them clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple customers, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.

- Ability to interpret customer usage and engagement data and translate it into actionable strategies.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

- Bachelor’s degree.

Preferred

- Familiarity with SaaS platforms, Customer Success methodologies, customer lifecycle management, and scalable engagement models.

- Experience creating customer onboarding, education, training, or self-service enablement content.

- Experience supporting renewals, revenue retention, or account expansion.

- Exposure to supply chain risk, third-party risk, compliance, cybersecurity, fraud, investigations, procurement, or public sector contracting.

- Experience working with CRM and Customer Success platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar tools.

Why Exiger

In this role, you will:

- A front-row seat to consequential work. Partner with leaders solving some of the most urgent supply chain and national security challenges of our time.

- The chance to build, not just inherit. Shape how we serve a rapidly growing customer base and leave your mark on the future of Customer Success at Exiger.

- A career-defining moment to join. Grow alongside a category-leading AI company with bold ambitions, strong momentum, and a mission the world increasingly needs.

- Move faster than the threat. Equip government and industry leaders with the intelligence they need to anticipate risk and stay ahead of adversaries.

Why You’ll Love Working at Exiger

We believe people do their best work when they are trusted, supported, and connected to a meaningful mission. At Exiger, you’ll be part of an ambitious, collaborative team—and have the flexibility, benefits, and opportunities you need to thrive.

- A high-performance culture built on accountability, collaboration, and shared success

- Discretionary Time Off with no maximum

- Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision benefits

- Competitive compensation

- 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

- A flexible hybrid work environment

- Wellness stipends and programming that support your well-being

- Career development opportunities and education reimbursement to help you keep growing

Human Resources Business Partner Director

As an emerging, high-growth, global organization, we are seeking a Human Resources Business Partner Director to serve as a strategic and highly hands-on talent and organizational partner to business leaders. This senior individual contributor role requires the ability to move seamlessly between advising all levels of leadership, solution design, and direct execution.

The Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) Director will partner with leaders across one or more business functions to translate business priorities into practical people strategies that strengthen organizational performance, leadership capability, employee engagement, workforce effectiveness, and talent outcomes. The role will also help leaders leverage AI, automation, and workforce data to improve capacity planning, build future-ready skills, increase productivity, and optimize how work gets done.

What You’ll Do:

-
Serve as a trusted strategic advisor and coach to leaders on talent, organization, workforce, leadership, and employee matters that impact business performance.

-
Develop and execute people strategies for assigned business functions, aligning organizational and talent priorities with business objectives, operating plans, and evolving workforce needs.

-
Lead organizational design, workforce planning, talent reviews, succession planning, performance management, and compensation planning for supported organizations.

-
Leverage AI, workforce analytics, and automation to assess capacity, model workforce needs, identify skill and capability gaps, and help leaders determine how work should be organized, staffed, automated, or augmented.

-
Partner with leaders to identify opportunities to build AI and future-ready skills, improve adoption of new ways of working, and strengthen workforce capability as business and technology needs evolve.

-
Operate as both strategist and practitioner, diagnosing challenges, designing solutions, building tools and materials, and personally driving execution through completion.

-
Use people analytics, workforce insights, AI-enabled tools, and business metrics to assess organizational health, productivity, efficiency, and output and translate findings into practical recommendations and action plans.

-
Coach leaders and managers on leadership effectiveness, team dynamics, performance, employee engagement, career development, and optimizing team structure and ways of working.

-
Lead the people aspects of organizational change, including restructurings, leadership transitions, operating-model changes, workforce actions, AI-enabled transformation, and other business change initiatives.

-
Partner across Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Learning & Development, Finance, Legal, and HR Operations to develop and implement integrated solutions that improve workforce capability, productivity, efficiency, and business outcomes.

What You Need:

-
10+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including significant experience in a strategic HR Business Partner role.

-
Demonstrated success as a senior individual contributor partnering with senior and executive leaders in complex, high-growth, or rapidly changing organizations.

-
Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to translate business priorities into practical organizational, workforce, and talent strategies.

-
Deep working knowledge of organizational design, workforce planning, talent and succession management, performance management, compensation, change management, and employee relations.

-
Demonstrated experience using AI, workforce analytics, automation, or emerging technologies to inform workforce capacity planning, identify skill gaps, improve productivity, or optimize organizational effectiveness.

-
Strong understanding of how AI is changing roles, skills, workflows, and workforce models, with the ability to help leaders determine where work can be redesigned, automated, augmented, or shifted.

-
Proven ability to move effectively between strategic advising, solution design, data analysis, project management, and hands-on execution.

-
Strong analytical capability with experience using people, workforce, productivity, and business data to identify insights, develop recommendations, and influence leadership decisions.

-
Exceptional executive communication, coaching, facilitation, judgment, and influencing skills, including the ability to constructively challenge senior leaders.

-
Demonstrated ability to operate independently with limited structure, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in ambiguous or resource-constrained environments; experience in technology, SaaS, AI, professional services, private-equity-backed, or similarly dynamic organizations preferred.

Senior Manager, Marketing Operations & AI Enablement

Location: McLean, VA or Richmond, VA

The Opportunity

The Senior Manager, Marketing Operations & AI Enablement will independently lead day-to-day marketing operations across campaign execution, email marketing, automation, lead management, reporting, and AI-enabled workflow improvement. This role owns the ongoing operation, optimization, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of the marketing systems, processes, and programs that help marketing run efficiently, improve performance, and scale execution.

The ideal candidate is a curious, technically skilled operator who can identify opportunities to improve how work gets done, optimize existing processes, and apply AI and automation in practical, measurable ways. This role will play a key part in improving marketing efficiency, strengthening email and campaign performance, and helping the team adopt smarter, more scalable ways of working.

What You Will Do

Marketing Operations Execution

- Manage day-to-day marketing operations across campaign workflows, lead routing, SLA alignment, data quality, and reporting.

- Support the execution and continuous improvement of processes that keep marketing programs running smoothly and efficiently.

- Help maintain consistent workflows, standards, and documentation across campaign and operational activities.

Email Marketing and Lifecycle Optimization

- Own and improve email marketing operations, including audience segmentation, testing, personalization, send optimization, performance analysis, and workflow automation.

- Support the development and optimization of nurture and lifecycle programs that improve targeting, engagement, and conversion.

- Apply testing and data analysis to improve email strategy and execution over time.

- Ensure email programs follow applicable consent, and privacy regulations and are in line with brand standards.

AI Enablement and Process Improvement

- Identify opportunities to improve existing marketing processes through AI, automation, and smarter workflow design.

- Design, build, and refine AI-assisted workflows for campaign intake, email production, segmentation, QA, lead management, reporting, and post-campaign analysis.

- Support the rollout of AI-enabled ways of working by turning team priorities into practical, repeatable processes.

- Test new tools and approaches where they can improve speed, quality, consistency, or performance.

Automation, Lead Management, and Reporting

- Manage and optimize marketing automation processes, including lead scoring/routing, form strategy, nurture flows, attribution support, and the AI SDR program.

- Maintain dashboards and reporting that track funnel performance, email effectiveness, campaign performance, process efficiency, and workflow improvements.

- Help ensure marketing data is accurate, actionable, and aligned to reporting needs across teams.

- Identify bottlenecks in campaign, email, and content operations and recommend improvements to reduce manual effort and increase throughput.

Cross-Functional Support and Enablement

- Partner with RevOps, Sales, IT, and Legal to support compliant and effective use of marketing automation and AI.

- Document workflows, standards, and best practices to improve consistency and scalability across the team.

- Support team adoption of new tools, processes, and AI-enabled ways of working through documentation, training, and hands-on problem solving.

What You Need

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Information Systems, or a related field.

- 5+ years of experience in marketing or revenue operations

- Strong experience with MAP, CRM, ABM, marketing automation, analytics, and lead management.

- Hands-on experience with email marketing strategy and operations, including segmentation, testing, deliverability, and performance optimization

- Experience implementing AI or automation within marketing workflows

- Experience designing, building, and optimizing workflows from start to finish.

- Strong technical troubleshooting skills, with the ability to independently identify root causes and resolve workflow, system, and automation issues.

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of operational execution and improvement.

- Strong analytical and technical skills. Experience working with APIs is preferred, knowledge of HTML is required.

The primary deliverable is measurable customer outcomes. EVRs are a mechanism for demonstrating value.
